scope: New joint-coverage postprocessing of unchanged old-DESI posterior. Source values are already known; no new outcomes, fits or primary changes.
band_family: Each coordinate lower/upper = stored median + t*(stored original 2.5/97.5 percentile - stored median). Same t for every coordinate in each selected finite grid. Solve posterior event probability=0.95, not a claim of unique/optimal envelope.
outputs: Joint posterior mass of unchanged stored pointwise95% bands.
Common expansion factor and expanded intervals for95% joint posterior mass.
All12 prior/model combinations, each for15-coordinate primary and33-coordinate full frozen grids.
Fixed-A monotonicity proof and numerical stored-quantile checks.

numerics.method: Own compressed Gaussian likelihood from retained CSV, analytic conditional truncated-Gaussian A integration, adaptive Omega quadrature with AP-support restriction and envelope/feasibility split points. Fixed-A event reduced to intersection of monotone Omega intervals.

fixed_A_theorem: For fixed A>0, DM,DH strictly decrease and AP strictly increases in Omega for all z>0. Exact equal-tail95% bands therefore have the same central95%Omega preimage; simultaneous coverage holds for finite grids and the complete positive-redshift curve within this background. Stored finite precision verified separately.
exclusions: No frequentist coverage or future measurement likelihood.
No Foundation population, covariance, calibration or outcome.
No continuous-z simultaneous claim for free-A finite-grid construction.
No model ranking changes or new public priority seal.
No publishing, spending, grants, contact or installation.
